adjustability.command.no_item: Hold an item in your main hand.
adjustability.command.not_adjustable: This item can't hold dormant enchantments (#adjustability:not_adjustable, or not in #adjustability:adjustable in allowlist mode).
adjustability.command.inspect.invalid: The stored split breaks Adjustability's rules (two active enchantments conflict, or a dormant one that isn't switched off conflicts with nothing). It's fixed the next time the item goes through an anvil.
adjustability.command.add.dormant: Added %s, dormant: it conflicts with an active enchantment.
adjustability.tutorial.open.title: Switch enchantments
adjustability.tutorial.open: Hover the item in your inventory and press %s.
adjustability.tutorial.bind_adjust: Bind Adjust in Controls, then press it over the item in your inventory.
adjustability.tutorial.cycle.title: Switch while mining
adjustability.tutorial.bind_cycle: Bind Cycle in Controls to switch the item in your hand.
adjustability.tutorial.cycle: Press %s to switch the item in your hand.
adjustability.profile.magenta.descriptio: Adjustability's own look: a dark panel, a magenta border and corner brackets. The defaults.
adjustability.profile.vanilla.descriptio: Looks like Minecraft's item tooltips: a purple border, no brackets, radio marks.
adjustability.profile.minimal.descriptio: A plain dark box with square marks: no border, no brackets, no cost line.
adjustability.profile.high_contrast.desc: Black and white with yellow for what's active, checkboxes, and a heading for each group.
adjustability.profile.bad_code: That isn't an Adjustability panel code.
adjustability.profile.newer_code: That code is from Adjustability %s, newer than yours (%s). Update to use it.
adjustability.profile.bad_name: %s can't be a profile name: use a-z, 0-9, _, - and . only.
adjustability.profile.built_in_name: %s is a built-in profile; pick another name.
adjustability.toggle.none: None of %s's group is active now
adjustability.toggle.disabled: Switching enchantments is turned off on this server.
adjustability.toggle.nothing_to_switch: Nothing to switch on this item.
adjustability.toggle.not_dormant: That enchantment isn't dormant on this item.
adjustability.toggle.would_switch_off_cu: Can't switch: a curse would be switched off.
adjustability.toggle.none_not_allowed: This server always keeps one of each group active.
adjustability.toggle.switch_off_not_allo: This server doesn't let you switch enchantments off.
adjustability.command.client_only: This part of /adjustability runs on the client; use it in game with the mod installed.
adjustability.command.help.keybinds: rebind the Adjust and Cycle keys
adjustability.command.help.toggle: make an enchantment on the held item active
adjustability.command.help.inspect: (operators) show the held item's active and dormant enchantments
adjustability.command.help.add: (operators) add an enchantment to the held item
adjustability.command.help.flatten: (operators) remove dormant enchantments from players' items
adjustability.command.flatten.done: Removed dormant enchantments from %s item(s) of %s player(s).
adjustability.command.help.panel: show or change the Adjust panel's look
adjustability.command.panel.header: Adjust panel settings (click one to change it):
adjustability.command.panel.footer: Colors: #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB. /adjustability panel profile <name> for a ready-made look, export or import <code> to share one, reset for the defaults.
adjustability.command.panel.reset: The Adjust panel's settings are back to their defaults.
adjustability.command.panel.profile: The Adjust panel now has the %s look.
adjustability.command.panel.saved: Saved the Adjust panel's look as the profile %s: %s
adjustability.command.panel.exported: The look's code, copied to the clipboard (click to copy again): %s
adjustability.command.panel.imported: The Adjust panel now has the look from that code.
adjustability.command.panel.skipped: Skipped what this version can't use: %s
adjustability.command.panel.unavailable: The settings file isn't loaded yet.

adjustability.configuration.title: Adjustability Settings
adjustability.yacl.server_locked: Server settings can only be changed in your own world (singleplayer or LAN host).
adjustability.yacl.server_not_loaded: Open a world to change server settings.
adjustability.yacl.copy_code.description: Copies a code for the look on this screen to the clipboard. Anyone can paste it to get the same look.
adjustability.yacl.paste_code.descriptio: Applies the look from a code on the clipboard. Settings the code leaves out go to their defaults; your key mode and side stay.
adjustability.jei.anvil: Adjustability: conflicting enchantments can be combined here, from a book or another item. What was active stays active; the new conflicting enchantment is kept dormant (listed with ⇄, doing nothing). Hover the item in any inventory and press the Adjust key (Left Alt) to choose which one is active. Two books with conflicting enchantments combine into one.
adjustability.jei.grindstone: Adjustability: a grindstone removes dormant enchantments too, and gives experience for them like for active ones. Curses stay.
